title: Yellow Dense Mexican Bean Tacos
description: A fermented, dense, and quick-fix Mexican dish featuring wholegrain mustard and dehydrated ingredients, friendly to anti-inflammatory diets. This recipe combines the flavors of Mexico with the convenience of a weeknight meal.
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium heat to cook the fermented pinto beans.
Add the wholegrain mustard, dehydrated onions, and dehydrated bell peppers to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the taco seasoning to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the bean mixture onto a tortilla and topping with shredded cheese, chopped cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve the tacos immediately and enjoy.
Store any leftover bean mixture in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Reheat the bean mixture in the microwave or on the stovetop before serving.
